list: 55 trophies: 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze. 0 online trophies. 28 hidden on PlayStation.

listSources.label: Names, grades and PSN targets — PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops on its own. Nothing here needs multiplayer or DLC: every trophy in the list is offline single-player, and PowerPyx rates the whole run about 200 hours at difficulty 4/10. The last trophy you earn will almost always be A Long Road (100% completion) or one of the big grinds like Cunning Stunts.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, impossible to miss. It pops when you finish the first main mission of Chapter 1, Gone Fishing. Just play the opening as the game teaches it to you; no side requirement is attached to it.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Finish every main mission of Chapter 1; it pops as Chapter 2 opens with What's in the Bag?. While you are still in Chapter 1, do the one thing in the whole list that can be missed: Lucia's balcony meditation at Jason's house (see Positive Mental Attitude).

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Finish Chapter 2; it pops as Chapter 3 opens with Welcome to Vice City. Chapter 2 is where the game opens up: after the mission Coffee Break you can switch between Jason and Lucia and roam together, which several later trophies need.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Finish Chapter 3; it pops after the first two Chapter 4 missions, Ocean Beach and Another Life. Chapter 3 is also where several questlines and tools unlock — Randy's car list, the Key Cloner, Yasmani's jewelry jobs — so take the side content as it appears.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Finish Chapter 4; it pops after the final Chapter 4 mission, Starting From Zero. Keep a manual save at the start of the chapter — there is no mission replay, and a chapter-start save is the cheap insurance PowerPyx recommends for the whole run.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, and one of only two golds. It pops when you complete the final mission, Starting From Zero, at the end of Chapter 4. After the credits the game returns you to free-roam, so everything left on the list can be cleaned up without starting over.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. It pops during the Chapter 2 main mission Breakfast Run. No extra objective is needed — there are no mission gold medals in this game, so just finish the mission.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. It pops during the Chapter 3 main mission The Cartel Heist. This is a story beat, not a robbery you have to set up yourself — the bank-vault robberies that count toward Maximum Withdrawal come later, in Chapter 4.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. It pops during the Chapter 4 main mission Child's Play. Like every mission trophy in this list, it cannot be missed as long as you finish the story.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. It pops during the Chapter 4 main mission Headliners. Nothing to prepare for it — play the mission through and it unlocks.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. It pops during the Chapter 4 main mission VCIA Takedown. The airport itself matters for another trophy later — Catch Me If You Can, stealing a docked passenger plane from VCIA — but that is a separate free-roam task, not this mission.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. It pops during the Chapter 5 main mission Operation Savage Glory, the last story chapter. After this mission the 100% Completion Checklist unlocks under Progress > Stats, which is the long second stage of the platinum run.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy in the list and the second gold. The checklist unlocks after the story at Progress > Stats > 100% Completion, but progress made during the story already counts, so scan vehicles and study animals as you go. PowerPyx stresses the requirements are lenient — closer to 60% true completion: most side quests are not needed, and of the collectibles you typically need only 70-80%. The parts that need everything are robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests; you need any 70 of the 80 challenges, and any 100 optional missions. Nothing toward 100% is missable — it can all be done in free-roam after the story.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts in the game: 130 Stunt Jumps, 202 Under the Bridges, 40 Knife Flights and 25 Base Jumps. You can mix categories freely, and PowerPyx calls the Under the Bridges runs the quickest to knock out. Track progress by region at Progress > Activities > Stunts, or on the map under Exploration > Stunt Spots, where each stunt keeps its own name and stays marked after you complete it. Note the 100% checklist wants 300 stunts, so this trophy pops on the way to A Long Road.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: The PSN tracker counts 9 activity types, and you need one of each: Fishing, Hunting, Golf, Shooting Ranges, Pool, Basketball (scoring hoops), playing a Video Game, winning a Car Race / Race Challenge / Top Fun Drone Race, and performing a Stunt. Check what you have done at Touchpad > Progress > Activities. PowerPyx notes you will be introduced to most of them through the story and the rest get marked when you unfog the map, so this usually pops on its own while you work on everything else.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: There are 12 Shooting Range locations with 42 challenges between them, and this trophy wants a gold medal in every one. PowerPyx links a full location guide and notes the gold medals are not too difficult. Shooting ranges also level up your Focus, which helps Gunslinger, and all 42 are required for the 100% checklist too, so do them once and do them properly.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at all 14 locations — 42 drone races in total across them. PowerPyx has a full location guide for all 14. These also count toward the 100% checklist, which wants every drone race done, so you cannot skip any of them on the road to A Long Road.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — the race has to be one you have not won before, so variety is the requirement, not repeats. PowerPyx counts 40 unique race locations in the game, so you have twice as many to choose from as you need. Pick the short ones and the vehicle classes you are comfortable with, and this pops well before you run out of fresh races.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 main mission Feng Shui, where you meet Cal, he will text you and mark a fishing location with a purple icon on the map. Follow Cal's fishing questline and beat him in the challenge it sets. Fishing itself is one of the 9 activity types for Master of None, so it pays to learn it early.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: There are 4 arcade games, called Video Games in-game: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind are playable on the TV at home by interacting with the controllers — you can start as early as Chapter 1 — and Bang For Your Buck is on arcade machines around the world. To complete a game you must finish all of its levels at least once; you do not need to beat every challenge inside it. Pick whichever of the four you like best and play it to the end.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's optional questline is exclusive to Lucia and gets marked automatically in Chapter 3: at some point while playing as Lucia you get a call from Andy, then a text with her home address in Belville. All of her quests are still available after the story. Complete the five quests — Climbing the Cellerichain (Parts 1-3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass — and the trophy pops after the last one.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's optional questline gets marked automatically in Chapter 1: a while after the mission Island Dreams, where you work for him, he calls and is marked with a green KR icon in Key Lento. He sends you diving for treasure at 7 shipwrecks — he marks purple chest icons on the map, you dig the treasure up with the metal detector and bring it back. Track it at Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees. He goes temporarily unavailable after Chapter 1, but he comes back in Chapters 2-3 (playing as Jason and calling Brian speeds it up), so nothing here is missable.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's optional questline gets marked automatically after the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break, at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County, and all of it is still available after the story. Complete his five quests — Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes — and the trophy pops after the last one.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Only certain strangers count toward this trophy, and several familiar questlines do not: Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie are not counted as strangers. The strands PowerPyx has confirmed so far are Kirk (the Skunk Ape quests), Kyle (McKittrick Farm), Yago (the street-racing strand — note his race against you is time-sensitive, marked with an hourglass) and Pilot Pete (the delivery strand), with more strangers still being discovered at launch. All of them remain available in free-roam after the story, and you can watch the count on the trophy tracker itself.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's questline, Randy's Wish List, gets marked automatically after the Chapter 3 main mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Zorrusso for him and unlock the Key Cloner. He then wants 16 sports cars delivered to his garage in the west of Vice City (green RK icon). You can steal them off the street anywhere — scan a car with the WAiNK app to check whether it is on the list — and the cars he marks for you appear mostly around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach. Delivering in good condition pays more. Track the list at Map > Robberies > Randy's Wish List.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's optional questline is Jason-only and gets marked automatically after the Chapter 3 main mission Here, Kitty Kitty. Purple markers for Synthetic Labs appear in Vice City: go to the labs and destroy them as part of the quest Take Out Kitty Litter. Once you have destroyed enough labs, Tyrone gives you the second quest, Spin On This, and the trophy pops when you shut the labs down. Everything is still available after the story.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: THE ONE TROPHY YOU CAN MISS. There are 18 meditation spots across 10 locations, and meditating with both Jason and Lucia at one spot counts as +2, so you need both characters together (unlocked after Chapter 2's Coffee Break). Track them at Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations. The trap is in Chapter 1: after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning — she says she is going to meditate, walks out to the balcony at Jason's house, and you follow her and choose Accept. That meditation is gone forever after Chapter 1 ends. PowerPyx says it is still unconfirmed whether that one meditation is strictly required for the trophy, but its author had done it when the trophy popped — so do it, and keep a Chapter 1 save until the trophy pops. For the 100% checklist only 15 of 18 meditations are needed, so the checklist itself is safe either way.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret Vogel's optional questline is Jason-only and gets marked after the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break: while playing as Jason you get a text from Bret marking his first quest, Veteran Hunted, in Lummox County. His quests are about hunting the animals he requests and bringing them to him. On the first quest he gives you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69, retrievable from any weapon locker at Ammu-Nation. One clean shot leaves an animal pristine and pays more, but it is not required. Track the hunts at Map > Activities > Target Deck — there are 15 Target Decks in total, and all 15 are required for the 100% checklist, so this trophy comes naturally on the way. PowerPyx notes it is still being confirmed exactly which animal pops the trophy.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete any 3 collectible card sets. PowerPyx has a location guide for all 18 card set locations, so the sets are findable rather than random: work through the sets one at a time and the trophy pops when your third set is complete. Cards are one of the collectible families tracked in the in-game Progress database, so you can see what you already have before you go hunting.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK scans are objects in the world you scan by holding D-pad Up and then R1: 31 Landmarks, 35 Curiosities and 23 Sculptures, plus No Flusher Tags. There are more than 100 in total, so it does not matter which 100 you scan — just scan as you travel. Since the WAiNK app is also how you scan the 200 vehicles for the 100% checklist, this trophy pops naturally while you work on Whip It Good.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: There are 80 challenges in 8 categories of 10, and this trophy wants any 50. The 100% checklist wants any 70, so this pops on the way to A Long Road. Track them at Progress > Challenges — each one shows a Completed checkmark when you scroll over it. Most complete themselves while you work on other trophies; leave this for late, then pick the easiest remaining ones instead of grinding the hardest ten.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: You can only do this after the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break, when Jason and Lucia can free-roam together — call your partner by holding D-pad Right and pressing Triangle. Build a 4-star wanted level (causing carnage is the fast way), then escape: a fast sports motorcycle cutting through traffic works well, and if a helicopter is on you, shoot at it until it leaves. The easiest route PowerPyx gives is the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County — police struggle to follow on the tracks and the helicopter cannot see you. The trophy pops when you drive out of the red heat zone, not when you leave the flashing search area. It also pops naturally during the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is…, since the large bank vault robberies there always trigger 4 stars.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: After Chapter 2's Coffee Break, call your partner (D-pad Right + Triangle) and hit 3 robbery targets in a row while the police are chasing you the whole time — you must keep the red/blue flashing wanted level, not lose it between shops. Bring an armored vest, sticky bombs and healing (Zombix or Adrenaline from Ammu-Nation). PowerPyx recommends the 3 jewelry stores in the north of Vice City, available after the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs: rob a couple of items in each store and break the safe in the back room with sticky bombs. The pop is delayed about half a minute after you leave the third shop, and if it does not fire, hit a fourth shop and keep going.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: The game has 557 vehicles at launch — cars, bikes, boats, helicopters and planes. The fast way is the WAiNK app on your phone (hold D-pad Up to open it instantly), then look at a vehicle and hold R1 to scan it; scanning is enough, you do not need to drive it. Stand on a busy road and scan everything passing by. Check your totals at Touchpad > Progress > Vehicles. The 100% checklist wants 200 of the 277 base-model vehicles scanned, so this trophy pops on the way to A Long Road.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Combat Focus is L3+R3 while aiming a firearm: time slows and vulnerable spots are highlighted, draining the purple focus bar under your health and stamina. You must drop 5 enemies inside one use, and the window lasts only a few seconds. Prepare first: eat or drink to buff focus, and use Adrenaline (hold L1, press Triangle) to stretch the focus time. Line up 5 enemies — PowerPyx suggests the criminals at gang operations — wear body armor from Ammu-Nation so you can step out of cover, and use an accurate full-auto rifle like the Duke 556. PowerPyx notes it does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians. Focus has 4 levels, raised by shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots; by the time you reach Focus level 4 this gets much easier, and it may well pop on its own.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal one of the large passenger planes docked at a departure terminal at VCIA (Vice City International Airport) — it must be one connected to a passenger boarding bridge, not the planes sitting on the airfield. The easiest is the one at terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence around the airfield, head straight to it, and next to the boarding bridge are stairs with a door leading directly into the plane. Go upstairs, enter the cockpit, drive the plane backwards to the airstrip and take off. The pop is delayed — you must fly 1 km (0.6 miles) away from the airport before it unlocks.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank. The tanks stand in the south of Mile Zero Air Station, the island on the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County. Drive through the gate — or take the stunt jump next to the south-east entrance — climb into a tank and start shooting enemies until the trophy pops. Expect heavy resistance on the base itself, so go in with armor and a plan to get out.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 3 main mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs: it unlocks the Snap Gun, which silently lockpicks alarmed doors, and it unlocks jewelry store robberies (green icons on the map in unfogged areas). Enter a store through the back door and choose the Snap Gun instead of kicking the door — kicking triggers the alarm. Inside the back room, look for the note with the safe code and use it to loot the safe. PowerPyx suggests Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City as a good location. The Snap Gun stays in your inventory permanently, so you never need to equip it.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe), which is marked automatically from story progress: you tail a security van until it stops at a bank, a guard carries a briefcase of cash in, the vault opens, and you go in fast to rob it — bring your partner and hold D-pad Right to hand off one bag, since you cannot carry all the cash alone. After that quest, pay Yasmani for tips about security vans ($10,000 each, after you have done his earlier quests robbing 2 Payday Loans) and the vans are marked purple on the map. Robbing a vault instantly gives a 4-star wanted level, so escape on a fast motorcycle and then switch vehicles to become unrecognizable. There are 8 large bank jobs in total: any 5 pop this trophy, all 8 are needed for the 100% checklist, and a single vault can pay up to $205,000 — the best money in the endgame.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: This pops automatically in the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… — the same mission that unlocks bank vault robberies — because robbing the vault of a large bank counts as robbing an armored truck. If you want it earlier, armored trucks drive around Vice City near banks: block one's path, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it up, then escape the red heat radius. Sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests, and Yasmani himself is unlocked as a fence from the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Fully unfog the whole map — the PSN target is 52 areas. The fastest way is by plane: fly over every part of the map still covered in black fog until the entire map is visible. PowerPyx has a guide for unfogging the map fast with the best plane to use. You will clear most of it naturally by driving the story and side content around, so save the last foggy corners for a single sweep at the end.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: There are 9 gangs and 39 illegal gang operations. For this trophy you only need one operation belonging to each gang, but the 100% checklist wants all 39, so it pops on the way to A Long Road. Operations are marked with yellow icons on the map when you go near them, and many are marked automatically from story progress. Track them at Progress > Gangs — scroll over a gang and the bottom right shows how many of its operations you have robbed.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: NOT YET CONFIRMED AT LAUNCH. PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown — no verified unlock method exists yet. The description suggests a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach, but nobody has pinned down the exact spot or trigger. Do not follow unverified methods from random videos; check back on the PowerPyx guide, which is being updated as players confirm it.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Steal one specific car from one specific showroom and drive it through the window: the blue Banshee from the vehicle showroom in the south of Vice City. You can only steal it after obtaining the Key Cloner in the Chapter 3 main mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS. Hack into the car, drive forward and straight through the window — the pop is slightly delayed and fires after you drive further down the street. It only unlocks from this blue Banshee, not any other car: it is an easter egg referencing the Banshee from GTA III.

trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn — one of the gang operations. Before going, buy sticky bombs at an Ammu-Nation, because you need them to destroy the safe. You go there during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling, which is marked automatically. Inside, pick up the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique shotgun variant Gutterball Moreland 850 on the table in the north-east corner, and loot the safe in the north-east hallway office (blow it with sticky bombs). The trophy pops after you escape the police, not when you grab the third item, and killing the enemies is not necessary. It is not missable: if you do not get all 3 items during the mission, the robbery icon respawns after a long while and you can go back for the rest.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Have maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. You can only start after the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break, when you can switch between both characters. Check strength at Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > select a character > Strength (heart icon). Raise it by working out — buy a fitness club membership and always go together with both characters (hold D-pad Right and press Triangle to call your partner): while you actively work out with one, the other completes their training automatically, so you make double progress. Filter fitness clubs on the map under Activities (dumbbell icon); there are plenty all over Vice City, and you can also work out at home after the story.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile — the PSN target is 500, and you can watch the count by clicking the trophy in the trophy list. PowerPyx recommends turning on Criminal Profile notifications first (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile = On): every time you do something that affects your reputation, a little demon face appears on the right side of the screen. The profiles run Professional (stealthy objectives, destroying evidence, clean escapes), Hardened (incapacitating without killing), Violent (killing enemies and civilians), Psycho (killing large numbers of cops and civilians, driving over gravestones) and Irredeemable — a permanent status if you keep using excessive violence, so avoid it, because cops get more aggressive. Most of the 500 will happen passively while you do robberies and fight through the other trophies; if you are short at the end, the fast farm is running over civilians and cops with a car.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: NOT YET CONFIRMED AT LAUNCH. PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, believed to be related to the Payday Loans store from the Prologue — but that is a belief, not a confirmed method. Do not waste a playthrough chasing it on a guess; check back on the PowerPyx guide, which is being updated as players confirm the unlock.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: NOT YET CONFIRMED AT LAUNCH. PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, believed to be from a UFO questline — but that is a belief, not a confirmed method. The description reads like a hidden encounter, so the sensible move is to keep playing the open world and check back on the PowerPyx guide once someone confirms the trigger.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: NOT YET CONFIRMED AT LAUNCH. PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, believed to be from kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle — a melee drive-by on two wheels. That is a belief, not a confirmed method, so treat it as a lead to test rather than a fact: try melee attacks from a motorcycle and check back on the PowerPyx guide for confirmation.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 3 main mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew), which unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer for laundering marked bills. Then rob banks and Payday Loans and bring the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The $250,000 is cumulative across all robberies, not one delivery. It comes naturally while you do robberies for the 100% checklist, and bank vaults pay up to $205,000 in a single robbery once they unlock after the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is….

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Simply spend a total of $100,000 across all types of shops — it is cumulative, not one purchase. The fastest way is the expensive stuff: guns, car mods and tattoos. The game has 14 mod shops, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 24 Ammu-Nations, 67 clothing stores, 17 footwear stores, 18 hair & beauty salons, 11 tattoo studios and 15 electronics stores, so you will pass plenty of places to spend. If you are short at the end, buy a few high-end weapon mods or a full car respray and tune.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: There are 8 purchasable garages plus 4 story-related ones, and this trophy wants only the 8 purchasable ones — $160,000 in total. They become available after the Chapter 2 main mission Daily Driver (Steal the Crawler for Moses): you get a notification that the Vice City Real Estate app has been installed on your phone, and you buy the garages through the app. The quick way to make the money is robberies, especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3-4. Garages also matter for On the Spot, since each one adds parking spots to register vehicles in.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: The Scooter Bros app is installed on your phone after the Chapter 2 main mission Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses). It lets you register stolen vehicles and have them delivered to your location. To register 10 vehicles you first need enough garages (see Little Boxes) — each garage adds one or more parking spots. Then drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn; in his garage click Respray and then Register. Initially he only accepts vehicles without trackers; later in Chapter 3 you can also register cars with Standard Trackers, at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registering costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes if you want to keep expenses down.

roadmap.title: Stage 1 — Play the story (60–80 hours)
roadmap.text: Finish the 5 chapters and enjoy the game. There are no mission gold medals and no mission replay, so you do not need to watch for hidden objectives — just finish each mission. Two habits pay off for the whole run: scan new vehicles with the WAiNK app and study new animals with the binoculars as you meet them (both count toward the 100% checklist later), and keep a manual save at the start and end of every chapter — 15 manual slots plus 1 autosave, no mission replay. The one thing you must not skip: Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1 (Positive Mental Attitude). Everything else trophy-related stays available after the story.

roadmap.title: Stage 2 — The 100% checklist (~100 hours)
roadmap.text: After the credits, the 100% Completion Checklist unlocks at Progress > Stats > 100% Completion. It is lenient — closer to 60% true completion. You need any 70 of the 80 challenges, any 100 optional missions, 200 of 277 base-model vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, and 300 stunts; the only parts that need everything are robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests. Work through the checklist and most of the activity, collectible and robbery trophies pop along the way.

roadmap.title: Stage 3 — Cleanup (~10 hours)
roadmap.text: With the checklist done, finish the 8 Strangers & Freaks strands, the character questlines (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, Bret), and whatever misc trophies are left — the four currently-unconfirmed hidden trophies may need a guide update before they can be chased. The platinum, Vice Got a Price!, pops with the last trophy you earn.
